comparator.role: context only, sealed, never re-flown; not read by the column passes

delivered.role: the flight's own delivered column (the LEFT side of both contrasts)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim; a shadow effect, never a system-level claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label, relisten value or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT SHADOW-COLUMN READ (owner decision 185; design section 4 with the section 8 rulings; claim ceiling 'nominated'). The DELIVERED column is the flight's own sealed answer, scored once by the flight with slurp-slu-official-train. Each shadow column -- relisten-replace-only (a: the section 1 acceptance rule) and relisten-replace-drop-unheard (b: a, plus dropping an entity when both contacts vote unheard) -- is rendered by the pure bind() from the same flight's sealed saea-relisten-v1 receipts and trace (AT1: a row with no accepted replacement and no drop renders byte-identical to the delivered text) and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch.score_complete_derived_copy; each contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915). PRIMARY: official pooled SLU-F1 (micro), shadow column minus delivered column. GUARD: intent is identical between each shadow column and the delivered column BY CONSTRUCTION (bind() never re-opens the decided intent); it is tested per row and the read REFUSES on any difference. THE BAR: the design's own null (ruling 7: 'the bar is the twin/shadow null'), provisional until this cell measures it: scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py design same-flight-shadow-relisten, 0.735 x sqrt(200 / n) = 0.3163 pp SLU-F1 at n = 1080. Per column: NOMINATED iff the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the point delta exceeds 0.3163 pp AND the intent guard holds; SHADOW HARM iff the SLU-F1 CI95 upper bound is below zero AND the point delta's magnitude exceeds 0.3163 pp; otherwise NOT NOMINATED (within the null). The two columns are two pre-declared rules read from one contact stream; no rule search (decision 179). A nomination claims nothing at system level: promotion means binding in delivery and a full-system read against an in-chain A/A (design section 4). Descriptive, never gating: saves and harms by error kind (gold read on the scoring side only), the per-type table, the blind-disposition and confirm-vote tallies, and equal-scenario weighting; every verdict carries the per-scenario table.
read_driver: scripts/flights/e4/e4_read.sh -> scripts/analysis/stage3_paired_read.py --right-column (direct mode, --per-scenario; the left side is the flight's own delivered score)
steps: 0. Refuse unless the READ row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-RELISTEN-FOLD-A-COLUMN-READ-V1 is root countersigned (checked by scripts/flights/e4/e4_read.sh before anything is opened).

1. Refuse unless the flight carries a COMPLETE sealed 1,080-row manifest with one successful complete official TRAIN score and a saea-relisten-v1 receipt on every non-abstention row verified by the bundle's I7l check.

2. Render both shadow columns (relisten-replace-only, relisten-replace-drop-unheard) from the sealed receipts and trace (AT1 self-check) and score each ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --mode relisten).
3. Intent guard: per row, the (scenario, action) of each shadow column must equal the delivered column's; any difference refuses the read.
4. Per column: paired row bootstrap of the column minus the delivered column (SLU-F1 primary); apply the rule at the provisional null 0.3163 pp.

5. Report the per-scenario table in both weightings, the per-type table, saves/harms by error kind (gold on the scoring side only), the blind-disposition and confirm-vote tallies, and the realised relisten contacts and audio against the declared cost.
title: Cell E4-1 -- the same-flight shadow-column read: relisten-replace-only and relisten-replace-drop-unheard, each against the delivered column, SLU-F1 primary, intent identical by construction
